messages:
Anya: FYI opened a PR to clean up the API reference for /generate (v2). There's a param name mismatch between the endpoint docs and several examples — some examples still use 'max_tokens' while the current API expects 'max_new_tokens' for incremental token control. Also the streaming example shows SSE but the request sample sends a wrong header. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2891

Ben: I can take the param rename and update the Python/Go SDK snippets. Do we want to keep legacy examples for older clients or fully migrate examples to v2 names? :thinking:

Anya: Let's migrate the canonical docs to 'max_new_tokens' for v2 and add a short "migration note" section that maps old names to new ones for legacy clients. That'll keep the docs clean but still help users upgrading.

Carmen: Quick question — do we need to bump the OpenAPI schema version? I noticed the requestBody schema in the swagger still lists 'max_tokens' in the example block. If we change examples.yaml we should regenerate the OpenAPI and double-check the example overrides.

Diego: I pulled the site generator locally. The samples are rendered from docs/examples.yaml + the per-endpoint templates. I can help trace where the old snippet is coming from — looks like an old example file under docs/snippets/generate.json.

Maya: Here's a minimal curl sample we should standardize across the page (and use in the quickstart):

```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2", "max_new_tokens":128, "prompt":"Write a haiku"}'
```

Ben: I'll update docs/examples.yaml and the Python snippet in the PR. Assigning to @Ben. I'll also add a tiny migration note under /docs/migration/v2-params.md and link it from the top of the API ref.

Anya: Carmen — can you validate the OpenAPI change and run the hosted validators? I don't want the hosted schema checks to fail on deploy.

Carmen: Yep, will run the swagger CI job and then the API lint. If anything breaks I'll post the error here.

docs-bot: CI: docs-build passed — preview available at https://deploy-preview-2891--docs.redwood.ai

Diego: One more nit — the streaming responses section should explicitly show the `Accept: text/event-stream` header and the SSE payload lines. Current example uses the `--http1.1` curl flag and an ambiguous chunked example that confuses readers. I'll open a small follow-up PR to replace that snippet with a clean SSE example.

Maya: I'll tweak the streaming example text and add a single-line note about when to use chunked transfer vs SSE to avoid user confusion.

Anya: Awesome, thanks everyone. Plan: Ben lands the examples + snippets, Carmen validates OpenAPI and CI, Diego follows up on streaming sample. Aim to merge by EOD PST. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
